The '''PaAR Five''' was one of the many rooms under the [[Defense Force Command Compound]].<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

During the [[Swarm War]], [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] summoned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and nephew [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] into the secret room after the successful coup of the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War" />
